_why: Lines between a cleaner that keeps up and one that does not: start reads before any work, end reads what the run left. Over a line, the reaper writes sanity.json; ops_watch files or reopens one fixed item per end. The pool's own cap comes from scratch_clone, not from here. Every line names its danger in _dangers (selftest_scratch_reap_sanity_dangers.py). Counts that name no danger are readings, not lines (CLAUDE.md, No limit without the danger it guards): selftest_stale, session_dirs, session_stale, refused and oldest_h rang SCRATCH_DIRTY_START/END about 300 times from 2026-11-23 to 2026-11-25 while / stood at 57% and every disk line read clear. rm_scratch_clones is a start line; at the end the line is rm_scratch_left, the rm/scratch clones the run left that are not young (2026-11-06: a live session's 17 young clones read 17 over 8). ops_watch reads the start rm_scratch_clones line for clones outside the pool.

_dangers.rm_scratch_clones: clones in rm/scratch sit outside the 16-clone pool cap and multiply fast; 2026-11-01 16 clones held 94 GB there, unseen by the pool
_dangers.rm_scratch_left: rm/scratch clones the run could not take outside the pool cap; they strand work and grow the disk, as on 2026-11-01 (94 GB)
_dangers.rm_scratch_gb: bytes in rm/scratch fill / outside the pool's disk floor; 2026-11-01 rm/scratch held 94 GB that the pool cap could not see
_dangers.refused_gb: bytes the cleaner may not take grow without bound; incident disk-20261115210535 held refused bytes over 1.0 GB
_dangers.root_disk_pct: a full / stops every clone, build, selftest and ledger write on the machine; it is the danger every other disk line stands in for
